title: select_channel can return invalid channel index
description:
File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:88

select_channel returns out-of-bounds channel index (1 to num_channels instead of 1 to num_channels-1).

**Failure scenario:** For EU868 (8 channels), calling select_channel(bytes.fromhex('0011223344556677'), epoch=2, density=4) returns 8, but valid indices are 0-7. Calling frequency(8) then raises ValueError: 'channel index 8 out of range [0, 8)'.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
close_reason: dup of gvgi root cause: select_channel output is a 1-based channel NUMBER per spec; frequency composition made total via validated mapping
